title: Putin’s Endgame: A Conversation With Fiona Hill

sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、扎伊兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: Ending the war in Ukraine very much depends on how and when Vladimir Putin allows it to end.
sentences.zh: 结束乌克兰战争很大程度上取决于弗拉基米尔·普京允许它如何以及何时结束。

sentences.en: In an interview for his podcast, The Ezra Klein Show, my colleague, opinion columnist Ezra Klein, spoke with one of the world's leading experts on Putin, Fiona Hill,
sentences.zh: 在为他的播客《埃兹拉·克莱因秀》所做的采访中，我的同事、评论专栏作家埃兹拉·克莱因与世界领先的普京问题专家之一菲奥娜·希尔进行了交谈，

sentences.en: a foreign policy advisor for the last three American presidents about exactly how Putin is approaching this moment and the right ways and wrong ways for the West to engage him.
sentences.zh: 她曾担任过三任美国总统的外交政策顾问，谈话内容正是关于普京目前如何看待这一时刻，以及西方与他接触的正确和错误方式。

sentences.en: It's Friday, March 11th.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月11日，星期五。

sentences.en: Fiona Hill, welcome to the show.
sentences.zh: 菲奥娜·希尔，欢迎来到本节目。

sentences.en: Oh, thanks so much, Ezra.
sentences.zh: 哦，非常感谢，埃兹拉。

sentences.en: So there are a lot of different frameworks being thrown around right now for how to think about Vladimir Putin.
sentences.zh: 现在关于如何看待弗拉基米尔·普京，有很多不同的框架被提出来。

sentences.en: There's Putin as a strategic, rational actor.
sentences.zh: 有人认为普京是一个战略性的、理性的行动者。

sentences.en: There's Putin as a nostalgic imperialiSt.
sentences.zh: 有人认为普京是一个怀旧的帝国主义者。

sentences.en: There's Putin, the unhinged maniac.
sentences.zh: 还有人认为普京是一个精神失常的疯子。

sentences.en: What is the model you're using for understanding Putin right now?
sentences.zh: 你现在用来理解普京的模型是什么？

sentences.en: Well, I think some of those models that you've just laid out do hold true.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为你刚才列出的一些模型确实成立。

sentences.en: Putin remains a strategic thinker.
sentences.zh: 普京仍然是一个战略思想家。

sentences.en: He's certainly got strategic goals that he's trying to fulfill, irrespective of whether we might think that those are mad goals from our perspective.
sentences.zh: 他当然有他试图实现的战略目标，无论我们从我们的角度来看这些目标是否疯狂。

sentences.en: These are goals that he has put forward for quite a period of time, including about Ukraine, but also about the rollback of NATO.
sentences.zh: 这些是他已经提出了相当长一段时间的目标，包括关于乌克兰的问题，也包括关于北约的撤回。

sentences.en: And what he sees is some kind of monumental struggle with the United States for Russia's right to exist in the world.
sentences.zh: 他所看到的是与美国之间某种为了俄罗斯在世界上生存权利的重大斗争。

sentences.en: And he certainly framed it in this way as well.
sentences.zh: 而且他当然也正是这样构架这个问题的。

sentences.en: And then there's all these kinds of questions about the way that he reads history, that he reads the situation around him, and the way that he has now over a long period of time.
sentences.zh: 此外，还有关于他解读历史、解读周围局势的方式，以及他长期以来一直如此行事的所有这些问题。

sentences.en: I mean, we have to remember, he's been in power for 22 years.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们必须记住，他已经掌权22年了。

sentences.en: After a period of time, it's, you know, you and the state, and particularly in the case of Putin, have become fused together.
sentences.zh: 经过一段时间，你知道，你和国家，特别是在普京的情况下，已经融为一体了。

sentences.en: And you can just sort of see it in the staging of everything.
sentences.zh: 你可以从这一切的布置中看出来。

sentences.en: I mean, we can all observe it as outside witnesses to his actions, the way that he sets up meetings,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，作为他行为的外部见证人，我们都能观察到，他安排会议的方式，

sentences.en: the rooms that he meets in with statuary of famous czars and czarinas of the past, including, you know, Catherine the Great,
sentences.zh: 他会见的房间里摆放着过去著名沙皇和沙皇后的雕像，包括，你知道，凯瑟琳大帝，

sentences.en: the way that people talk about him as being the only decision-maker in the Russian state, and the way that he has taken everything personally and made everything personal
sentences.zh: 人们谈论他是俄罗斯国家唯一的决策者，以及他把一切都个人化，并使一切都成为个人问题的方式，

sentences.en: in his pronouncements on the conflict in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 在他关于乌克兰冲突的声明中。

sentences.en: So for him, the state and Vladimir Putin have become fused together.
sentences.zh: 所以对他来说，国家和弗拉基米尔·普京已经融为一体了。

sentences.en: And what I fear about when he gets the state of his mind then, is that he sees himself as infallible.
sentences.zh: 而我所担心的是，当他处于那种心态时，他认为自己是绝对正确的。

sentences.en: Because he's decided to do something, therefore it should be done.
sentences.zh: 因为他决定做某事，所以它就应该被完成。

sentences.en: Do you believe that he is the only decision-maker in the state?
sentences.zh: 你认为他是国家唯一的决策者吗？

sentences.en: Well, he can't possibly be the only decision-maker, because the decisions have to be made in the heat of battle that we're seeing right now by the generals on the ground.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他不可能是一个人做所有决定，因为我们现在看到的战斗正酣，决定必须由前线的将军们做出。

sentences.en: But he's certainly at the apex of a very narrow decision-making vertical.
sentences.zh: 但他确实处于一个非常狭窄的决策垂直体系的顶端。

sentences.en: I mean, the Russians call this the vertical of power.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，俄罗斯人称之为权力垂直体系。

sentences.en: It's not even just a pyramid, because it's just kind of a pole that Putin is at the top of.
sentences.zh: 这甚至不仅仅是一个金字塔，因为它更像是一根普京站在顶端的杆子。

sentences.en: But clearly, this latest assault on Ukraine, in the context of everything else that's been going on, that's been decided by Putin,
sentences.zh: 但显然，这次对乌克兰的最新攻击，在所有其他正在发生的事情的背景下，是由普京决定的，

sentences.en: along with a very small number of military officials, and perhaps a handful of security officials around him.
sentences.zh: 连同极少数军事官员，或许还有他身边的一小撮安全官员。

sentences.en: Before we get into how Putin sees the Russian lands, because we're going to spend a bit of time there today, I want to ask about how he understands the West,
sentences.zh: 在我们探讨普京如何看待俄罗斯领土之前——因为我们今天会花点时间讨论这个——我想问一下他是如何理解西方的，

sentences.en: because I'm not hearing that analysed so much.
sentences.zh: 因为我没有听到太多关于这方面的分析。

sentences.en: You're seeing a lot of Putin's imperial rhetoric discussed.
sentences.zh: 你看到很多关于普京帝国主义言论的讨论。

sentences.en: But what does Putin think we want?
sentences.zh: 但普京认为我们想要什么？

sentences.en: When you read his speeches, when you listen to his comments, what is his model of us?
sentences.zh: 当你阅读他的演讲，听他的评论时，他对我们的模型是什么？

sentences.en: Well, his model of us is quite negative, to say the leaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗯，至少可以说，他对我们的模型是非常负面的。

sentences.en: And everything that we see today just underscores that Putin believes that we're literally out to get him.
sentences.zh: 我们今天看到的一切都强调了普京相信我们确实在针对他。

sentences.en: You know, the more that we talk about crushing the Russian economy, you know, there's loose talk by people now about, well, this will only end if Putin disappears.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们谈论摧毁俄罗斯经济的次数越多，你知道，现在人们有一些随意的谈话，说，嗯，这只有在普京消失时才会结束。

sentences.en: This just feeds in to this mentality that Russia is always under siege, its leaders are always under siege, people always want regime change in Russia.
sentences.zh: 这只会助长这种心态，即俄罗斯总是处于被围困状态，其领导人总是处于被围困状态，人们总是想在俄罗斯进行政权更迭。

sentences.en: Every time he looked at something that happened, for example, in the so-called coloured revolutions or uprisings, the Arab Spring, what happened?
sentences.zh: 每当他看到发生的事情，例如，在所谓的颜色革命或起义、阿拉伯之春中，发生了什么？

sentences.en: You saw Hosni Mubarak, the long-standing leader of Egypt, basically pushed out of power and, you know, ending up in a prison cell, you know, for example.
sentences.zh: 你看到埃及长期领导人胡斯尼·穆巴拉克基本上被赶下台，你知道，最终进了监狱，你知道，举个例子。

sentences.en: Even worse, you saw Muhammad Gaddafi shot by rebel forces in what looked like a drainage pipe.
sentences.zh: 更糟糕的是，你看到穆罕默德·卡扎菲在看起来像排水管的地方被反叛武装射杀。

sentences.en: And, you know, we hear stories that Putin played that image to himself over and over again, working himself into more of a state of paranoia.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我们听说普京一遍又一遍地播放那个画面给自己看，让自己陷入了更严重的偏执状态。

sentences.en: The overthrowing of Saddam Hussein and, you know, his hanging in Iraq.
sentences.zh: 萨达姆·侯赛因被推翻，你知道，他在伊拉克被绞死。

sentences.en: This is what Putin thinks about.
sentences.zh: 这就是普京所想的。

sentences.en: He thinks that the United States is in the business of regime change.
sentences.zh: 他认为美国从事的是政权更迭的勾当。

sentences.en: And there are always, throughout history, there's been some malevolent force, mostly coming from the West, he's discounting for now the Mongols from the East,
sentences.zh: 而且纵观历史，总有一种邪恶的力量，大多来自西方——他现在忽略了来自东方的蒙古人——

sentences.en: mostly coming from the West, who is out to basically push change in Russia, subjugate Russia, and basically install its own version of Russian power.
sentences.zh: 大多来自西方，旨在从根本上推动俄罗斯的变革，征服俄罗斯，并基本上安装其自己版本的俄罗斯权力。

sentences.en: So, unfortunately, right now, even all of the events of the present are feeding into that kind of mentality.
sentences.zh: 所以，不幸的是，现在，即使是当下的所有事件都在助长那种心态。

sentences.en: Putting aside the question of malevolence, is he on some level right that the US and the West are in the business of regime change, not just in Russia, but in Ukraine,
sentences.zh: 撇开邪恶的问题不谈，他在某种程度上是否正确，即美国和西方确实在从事政权更迭的勾当，不仅是在俄罗斯，而且是在乌克兰，

sentences.en: in some of the other places you mentioned and didn't mention?
sentences.zh: 以及你提到和没提到的一些其他地方？

sentences.en: I've been thinking a bit about this narrative by the political scientist Samuel Sharap, who has been arguing that you can't understand
sentences.zh: 我一直在思考政治学家塞缪尔·沙拉普的这种叙述，他一直认为，如果不理解这是乌克兰影响力争夺的双向竞赛，

sentences.en: Russia's actions in the region without understanding this is a two-way contest for influence in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 就无法理解俄罗斯在该地区的行动。

sentences.en: We've done a lot over the past 15,
sentences.zh: 在过去的15、

sentences.en: 20 years to try to bring them closer to us, not just opening NATO, but supporting Western leaders, training a generation of military officers, actually arming them,
sentences.zh: 20年里，我们做了很多努力试图让他们更接近我们，不仅是开放北约，还支持西方领导人，培训一代军事官员，实际上武装他们，

sentences.en: integrating them into EU licensing and trade and regulatory regimes.
sentences.zh: 将他们纳入欧盟的许可、贸易和监管体系。

sentences.en: And so he sees there as being a genuine, constant expansionary pressure from us that he's now trying to beat back.
sentences.zh: 所以他认为我们有一种真实的、持续的扩张压力，他现在正试图将其击退。

sentences.en: Is there validity to that view?
sentences.zh: 这种观点有道理吗？

sentences.en: Well, sure.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当然。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, that's the way that Putin definitely sees things.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你知道，这绝对是普京看待事物的方式。

sentences.en: But what that does is totally deny any agency on the part of Ukraine or any other country for that matter, right?
sentences.zh: 但这样做完全否定了乌克兰或任何其他国家的主体性，对吧？

sentences.en: If you think around the world as well, many countries have fought for their independence, you know, precisely because people themselves want to.
sentences.zh: 如果你也想想世界各地，许多国家为独立而战，你知道，正是因为人们自己想要独立。

sentences.en: What about the United States, for example?
sentences.zh: 那么美国呢，例如？

sentences.en: You know, we look back in US history.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们回顾美国历史。

sentences.en: This is like 1812.
sentences.zh: 这就像1812年。

sentences.en: And, you know, the US has had the French, you know, we've had the Spanish, we've had the, you know, the British Empire.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，美国曾有法国人，你知道，我们曾有西班牙人，我们曾有，你知道，大英帝国。

sentences.en: Obviously, we've had all kinds of manifestations and, you know, we have our own version of our own history, you know, might look very different, you know,
sentences.zh: 显然，我们有各种各样的表现形式，而且，你知道，我们有我们自己版本的历史，你知道，看起来可能非常不同，你知道，

sentences.en: from a different vantage point.
sentences.zh: 从不同的角度来看。

sentences.en: You know, you think about all of the other countries of Europe that have got their independence from the dissolution of empires.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你想到所有其他从帝国解体中获得独立的欧洲国家。

sentences.en: Poland, the Czech Republic and Slovak Republic, Finland.
sentences.zh: 波兰、捷克共和国和斯洛伐克共和国、芬兰。

sentences.en: You know, Sweden was once an empire and had, you know, kind of basically dominion over many of these lands as well.
sentences.zh: 你知道，瑞典曾经是一个帝国，也曾对许多这些土地拥有统治权。

sentences.en: The United Kingdom, you know,
sentences.zh: 大不列颠，你知道，

sentences.en: Ireland is an independent country now as well.
sentences.zh: 爱尔兰现在也是一个独立的国家。

sentences.en: A lot of what's happening now is a kind of a post-colonial, post-imperial impulse on the part of Russia.
sentences.zh: 现在发生的很多事情是俄罗斯的一种后殖民、后帝国的冲动。

sentences.en: This kind of feeling that it can't possibly be that lands and peoples want to go their own way, but there must be some other malevolent force there.
sentences.zh: 这种感觉是，土地和人民不可能想要走自己的路，而一定是有某种其他的邪恶力量在那里。

sentences.en: And when a country makes an appeal to another country, you know, for association or to a, you know, different international franchise, let's put it that way,
sentences.zh: 当一个国家向另一个国家提出诉求，你知道，为了结盟或为了一个，你知道，不同的国际特许权，我们这么说吧，

sentences.en: and wants to be part of that, that's seen as that other entity, be it NATO or the European Union, or, you know, bilateral relations with the US or anything else,
sentences.zh: 并希望成为其中的一部分，这被视为那个实体，无论是北约还是欧盟，或者，你知道，与美国的双边关系或其他任何东西，

sentences.en: that those countries are acting with malevolent force to pull them away.
sentences.zh: 那些国家正在以邪恶的力量行动，试图把他们拉走。

sentences.en: So what Putin can't make sense of, in fact, most people looking at it seem to not be able to make sense of, that people of Ukraine actually kind of want to live
sentences.zh: 所以普京无法理解的是，事实上，大多数观察它的人似乎都无法理解，乌克兰人民实际上有点想生活

sentences.en: like people of Ukraine in their own state and make their own decisions.
sentences.zh: 像乌克兰人一样在他们自己的国家，并做出他们自己的决定。

sentences.en: If they want to associate with the European Union and NATO for their security, then a lot of that is their decision as well.
sentences.zh: 如果他们为了安全想要与欧盟和北约结盟，那么这在很大程度上也是他们的决定。

sentences.en: So when we frame it that way, we completely and utterly negate the opinions and the beliefs and the aspirations of other people on the ground.
sentences.zh: 所以当我们那样构架它时，我们完全彻底地否定了当地其他人的观点、信仰和愿望。

sentences.en: That's what Putin is trying to do all the time.
sentences.zh: 这就是普京一直在试图做的事情。

sentences.en: So he's really done a great job in propaganda internationally, and we feed into it all the time.
sentences.zh: 所以他在国际宣传方面确实做得很好，而我们一直在助长它。

sentences.en: And again, it's this framed as a conflict, a proxy conflict between Russia and the United States and Russia and NATO for Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 再一次，这被构架为一场冲突，一场俄罗斯与美国、俄罗斯与北约之间为了乌克兰的代理人冲突。

sentences.en: Well, why do we want Ukraine?
sentences.zh: 那么，我们为什么要乌克兰？

sentences.en: People keep asking that.
sentences.zh: 人们一直在问这个问题。

sentences.en: We don't want Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我们不想要乌克兰。

sentences.en: The United States does not want Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 美国不想要乌克兰。

sentences.en: Just to make it very clear, we're not going to annex Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 为了说得非常清楚，我们不会吞并乌克兰。

sentences.en: It's not going to come like Puerto Rico and it's going to come an additional state.
sentences.zh: 它不会像波多黎各那样成为一个额外的州。

sentences.en: We're not annexing part of Europe.
sentences.zh: 我们没有吞并欧洲的一部分。

sentences.en: This is not World War II or the Cold War.
sentences.zh: 这不是第二次世界大战或冷战。

sentences.en: We are not occupying Europe anymore.
sentences.zh: 我们不再占领欧洲了。

sentences.en: Well, there's something he's been emphasizing that seems to me to be very much part of that idea, which is I think we're comfortable in a geopolitical moment like this
sentences.zh: 嗯，他一直在强调一些事情，在我看来，这似乎非常属于那个想法的一部分，即我认为我们在这样的地缘政治时刻感到舒适，

sentences.en: talking about security interests,
sentences.zh: 谈论安全利益，

sentences.en: Ukraine and NATO,
sentences.zh: 乌克兰和北约，

sentences.en: Ukraine and the EU,
sentences.zh: 乌克兰和欧盟，

sentences.en: Ukraine and Russia, arms, training.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰和俄罗斯，武器，训练。

sentences.en: Something that Putin has emphasized in a number of speeches is identity, language, ethnicity.
sentences.zh: 普京在多次演讲中强调的一点是身份、语言、种族。
